args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 — Combined Summary (Bellwether main + companion)
args.body:
- Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the resulting savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
- Pilot programs cut claims by a quarter.

Sources: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/cold-chain and https://insights.bellwether.example/cold-chain/companion
